title: ELBO$_{\mathrm{TDS}}$: Temporal Distribution Shift Generalization for Industry-Scale Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2511.21032v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Temporal distribution shift (TDS) degrades the generalization of recommender systems: models trained on past interactions face systematically different user behavior in future time windows. While incremental training on recent data is widely used in industrial production, it can over-adapt to transient patterns and exacerbate instability. Existing approaches such as invariant learning and self-supervised learning offer partial solutions but often suffer from unstable temporal generalization, representation collapse, or inefficient data utilization. To address these limitations, we propose ELBO$_{\mathrm{TDS}}$, a probabilistic framework for temporally robust recommendation. First, we identify key shifting factors in real-world production data and design a simple yet effective data augmentation strategy that simulates realistic time-varying factors and expands the training support. translated_title: ELBO$_{\mathrm{TDS}}$：面向工业级推荐系统的时间分布偏移泛化
translated_abstract: 时间分布偏移（TDS）会降低推荐系统的泛化能力：在历史交互数据上训练的模型，在未来的时间窗口中会面临系统性不同的用户行为。虽然基于近期数据的增量训练在工业生产中被广泛使用，但它可能过度适应瞬态模式并加剧不稳定性。现有方法（如不变学习和自监督学习）提供了部分解决方案，但往往存在时间泛化不稳定、表征崩溃或数据利用效率低下等问题。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 ELBO$_{\mathrm{TDS}}$，一个面向时间鲁棒推荐的概率框架。首先，我们识别了真实生产数据中的关键偏移因素，并设计了一种简单而有效的数据增强策略，该策略能够模拟真实的时间变化因素并扩展训练数据的支持范围。其次，我们推导了一个自监督变分目标（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了 ELBO$_{\mathrm{TDS}}$ 概率框架，通过识别时间分布偏移的关键因素、设计模拟时变因素的数据增强策略以及自监督变分目标，解决工业级推荐系统因时间分布偏移导致的泛化能力下降问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ELBO$_{\mathrm{TDS}}$, a probabilistic framework that tackles temporal distribution shift generalization in industry-scale recommender systems by identifying key shifting factors, designing a data augmentation strategy that simulates realistic time-varying factors, and deriving a self-supervised variational objective.
